title: PACE-ECG: Patient-Aware Contrastive ECG Pretraining; Leveraging Longitudinal Structure for Transferable Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.12307v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Foundation models for physiological signals are commonly evaluated on in-domain interpretation tasks, but their ability to transfer to longitudinal clinical prognosis across healthcare systems remains uncertain. We developed PACE-ECG, an ECG pretraining framework that combines contrastive learning across temporally neighbouring recordings from the same patient with clinically guided multitask supervision. We evaluated frozen ECG representations for post-myocardial-infarction all-cause mortality and incident heart failure prediction across MIMIC-IV and two external HEEDB cohorts, comparing the proposed representation with DeepECG-SSL, a state-of-the-art model, and two control baselines. translated_title: PACE-ECG：患者感知的对比式心电图预训练；利用纵向结构实现可迁移的表征
translated_abstract: 生理信号基础模型通常在域内解读任务上进行评估，但其在不同医疗系统之间向纵向临床预后迁移的能力仍不确定。我们开发了PACE-ECG，这是一种心电图预训练框架，将同一患者时间上相邻记录间的对比学习与临床指导的多任务监督相结合。我们在MIMIC-IV和两个外部HEEDB队列上评估了冻结的心电图表征用于心肌梗死后全因死亡率和新发心力衰竭的预测，并将所提出的表征与最先进的模型DeepECG-SSL以及两个对照基线进行比较。在两个下游任务中，所提出的模型在域内均优于DeepECG-SSL（死亡率AUROC提升1.9%，心力衰竭提升4.0%），并在HEEDB-波士顿外部人群中表现更优（死亡率提升5.6%，心力衰竭提升10.3%），在HEEDB-亚特兰大（提升6%……
tldr: PACE-ECG通过结合同一患者时间相邻心电图记录间的对比学习与临床指导的多任务监督进行预训练，其冻结表征在心肌梗死后死亡率和心衰预测任务上于MIMIC-IV及外部HEEDB队列均超越现有最先进模型，展现出优异的跨医疗系统迁移能力。
en_tdlr: PACE-ECG combines contrastive learning across temporally neighboring ECG recordings from the same patient with clinically guided multitask supervision, yielding frozen representations that outperform state-of-the-art models on post-infarction mortality and heart failure prediction across MIMIC-IV and external cohorts, demonstrating strong cross-healthcare-system transferability.
